name: response schema
description: The JSON representation of 5 question objects, to be rendered by a React.js component in the frontend.

questions.description: Required. The array of 5 question objects.

question.description: Required. This the question text the user will see in the frontend.

answers.description: Required. An array of 4 answer objects, one will be correct, the other three will be incorrect.

correct.description: Required. A boolean representing whether the answer is correct or not.

explanation.description: Required. The user facing explanation of whether the selected answer is correct or not.

text.description: Required. The text of the answer itself.

image_url.description: Optional. If the question references a traffic sign, this string is the url of the image. Will be displayed to the user. The url itself must be taken from the `signs` object.
